_how: This file is the whole editorial surface of /reels. To FEATURE a reel: open the reel on Instagram, Share -> Copy link, then append an entry to `featured` below and merge. Vercel redeploys on merge and the reel appears at the top of /reels. Any instagram.com /reel/ /p/ or /tv/ link works. `by` is the handle shown under the card (no @), `title` is an optional one-line caption. Remove an entry to unfeature it. The account grids need no upkeep at all: Instagram serves each profile's latest posts into the page itself. See REELS.md at the repo root for the full guide.
